- Drag a tab to another group to move it"},{"id":"p8s2","text":", or to an edge to split; toolbar buttons split right or down.
- At widths up to 760 pixels, one ful"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"l-width group is shown at a time with a group switcher.
- Switching to single-column mode or another"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" main panel hides the docked panes; returning restores the groups.
- Closing a tab changes only the "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"browser layout and never deletes its DSH Session. Open Sessions from the group menu or the DSH side"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"bar, then drag tabs or use the split buttons to arrange them."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Performance and limitations"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The iframe pool keeps every group's active tab plus the two most recently used inactive tabs mounted"},{"id":"p20s2","text":". Revisiting an evicted tab reloads its embedded client. Each shared panel keeps an iframe per works"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"pace visited through its selector, preserving that workspace's native tabs until page reload. More g"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"roups and workspaces therefore use more browser memory and DSH Web connections."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A shared right sidebar keeps native file-preview tabs open independently of Session and group select"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ion. File links from any conversation open in that same sidebar; collapsing it preserves its content"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"s. The Files tab lists every Workspace as an independent root, loaded on expansion, so multiple proj"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ects can be browsed together. Session switches leave the file tree and open previews unchanged. File"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"-tree and preview state last for the current page and are reset on reload. The right-sidebar workspa"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ce selector explicitly chooses the owner for session-scoped tools such as terminals and Git; changin"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"g the active conversation leaves this selection unchanged. Switching the selector restores that work"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"space's native tabs. Archived Sessions and subagent routes use the native conversation view. Touch l"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"ayouts use split buttons and the group switcher instead of tab dragging."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"With `dsh-better-sidebar` installed, a shared bottom workbench spans the conversation area below all"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" groups. Its workspace selector is independent of both the right sidebar and the active conversation"},{"id":"p22s3","text":". Switching workspaces or collapsing the panel keeps its terminals and tabs mounted. Open it from th"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"e bottom-panel button beside the right-sidebar button in the outer tab bar; drag its top edge to res"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ize, or focus the separator and use the arrow keys. Fullscreen and single-column mode retain the sam"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"e workspace ownership. The panel is available only while the companion plugin is enabled."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Only layout preferences are stored locally. The plugin does not copy Session logs, prompts, approval"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"s, or files, and all embedded pages are same-origin. It adds no model-visible prompts, tools, messag"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"es, or Session events."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness `^0.2.1-rc.2` and Cordis `^4.0.5`.
